builds.flags: -O3 -DNDEBUG with all registered Snappy SIMD and CRC feature macros disabled
-O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined with the same scalar feature defines

known_limitations: Snappy raw has no framing layer, footer, checksum, dictionary, random access, or common continuous-stream protocol and is not directly comparable with framed codecs.
lzbench CMakeLists.txt and NEWS identify 1.2.2, while its checked-in generated snappy-stubs-public.h still reports patchlevel 1; vendor files remain unmodified and the discrepancy is preserved.
The registered variant fixes compression level 1, scalar feature macros, one CPU thread, and one raw stream per independently measured object.
The Python FFI descriptor serialization and contiguous byte materialization are included in the declared adapter boundary.
LeakSanitizer cannot run under the host container ptrace policy; ASan/UBSan qualification uses detect_leaks=0.
